subject: Inline notice / what happens to focus on retry

messages.text:
Hi Luis,

I've got the inline notice ready for the v2 library apart from the retry case. At the moment the recovery button disappears as soon as you press it. Fine with a mouse, but on a keyboard I can end up all the way back on the address bar. You can see it if you tab through the little invoice example and use the retry button after it says it couldn't save.

I'd keep the button in place while the request runs and change its label to ‘Retrying…’. When it succeeds we can put focus back on Save, since that's where you were before the failure. The edge case is when the notice turns up by itself; there's no Save button to get back to then.

- The notice needs to stay mounted while the result comes back.
- Callers that have a button to go back to can pass it in as `returnFocusTo`.
- Can we leave the informational example alone? It has no action and I'd rather keep the props we publish for that one small.

Anil

Anil,

Keep Retry in place during the request. For the invoice, yes, send focus back to Save on success. If the save fails again, can we keep focus where it is and change the line beneath the button?

Thanks,
Luis

Luis Cordero
Lead Product Designer, Acme Studio
3rd floor, 48 Turnmill Street, London EC1M 5RR
acme.example

Hi Luis,

Yes. The bit under Retry is now announced once when the second failure comes back. I tried keeping the new message in the button label and got both read out, so I've taken that change out. The button reads Retry again.

The preview still has a link called Example two. That's the one without a `returnFocusTo`. On success it leaves the confirmation visible in the same spot until the next action on the page.

Anil

Tested both with Tab. Good to publish in v2.

Thanks,
Luis

Luis Cordero
Lead Product Designer, Acme Studio
3rd floor, 48 Turnmill Street, London EC1M 5RR
acme.example

Inline notice is in v2. The invoice example is the one with the return target.

Anil

facts: Retry stays mounted during the request.
In the invoice example, success restores focus to Save; a second failure keeps focus on Retry and announces the changed notice text once.
The example without a return target leaves the confirmation in place until the next action.

I'm Nesta from Bankstone Breakfast Club. We spoke by the gates at Mabley Green when I was trying to get the big hot water urn onto the trolley. You said you might be free to help in November so I thought I'd ask you directly.

Could you take tickets at the door from 10 to 11 on Saturday 7 November? We're doing a cooked breakfast at St Oswin's hall to raise money for winter food parcels. I'll be doing the hot food at that point and I need someone to mark off the families as they come in. If you can, just say yes by Wednesday 28 October and I'll put you on the sheet.

Nesta

truth.summary: Nesta asked Luis to take tickets at a Bankstone Breakfast Club fundraiser for one hour and is waiting on his answer.
ownerOwes: Tell Nesta by 28 October whether he can take tickets at the door.
facts: The shift is 10:00–11:00 at St Oswin’s hall on 7 November.
The breakfast raises money for winter food parcels; the job is marking off families as they arrive.

Dear Luis,

We're writing to the 2018 MA group to find out what graduates are doing now. We're gathering this for the course review in November. The form asks what sort of work you do and if you still use the studio facilities or alumni events. You can leave any item blank.

If you have five minutes, the form is at https://carrickarts.example/alumni/ma18. I've attached the paper copy for anyone who prefers to fill it in by hand. The names come off the form before the course team sees the answers.

Best wishes,

Elin Morley
Alumni Office, Carrick School of Arts

Elin said names are removed before the course team sees the answers.

subject: Cancelo la llamada del jueves

messages.text:
Hola, Alejandra:

¿Le parece si quitamos la segunda llamada del jueves a las 11:00 de Puebla? La habíamos apartado por si no se entendía la hoja de inventario, pero ya pude revisarla. La cotización sigue para el viernes 23.

Saludos,

Luis Cordero
Diseño de marca y producto
hola@luiscordero.example · +44 7700 900 418

Buenas tardes, Luis:

Sí, cancele esa llamada. Para el viernes, ¿puede poner por separado el precio de la fotografía por pieza y el costo de cargar el catálogo? Es probable que un taller nos entregue sus propias fotos. Lo que sí queremos que haga usted es la carga.

Saludos,
Alejandra

Buenos días, Luis:

Ya quité del calendario la llamada de hoy. Encontré la foto que me dio el taller de la taza miel y viene muy pequeña. Deje por favor la fotografía por pieza como opción para las 24 por si hay que repetirlas.

Saludos,
Alejandra

facts: La cita cancelada era el 22 de octubre a las 11:00 de Puebla.

Al 22 de octubre la cotización seguía pendiente.

subject: cake card for the book table

messages.text:
Dear Luis,

Could you make me a little card for the almond sponge?  One that can be read from across a dim room, which my front room is in November whatever I do with the lamps.  My handwriting would defeat the purpose.  Somebody at the September meeting turned out not to eat nuts and I only found out when she had eaten round the pears.

Yours,
Hamish Fairweather
yep. i'll send you a printable one by next tuesday, the 27th. i'll make ‘contains almonds’ the biggest thing on it.
